programme.desc: Cruise the Mediterranean and discover the beauty of Greece, Malta, and Sicily.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Experience Cambodia's ancient temples, luxury resorts, and rich culture.

programme.title: Laura McKenzie's Traveler
programme.desc: Discover the history, villages, and wineries of Rome's Lazio region.

programme.title: Elizabeth Stanton's Great Big World
programme.desc: Elizabeth, Rob, and Jennifer fly into the wild blue yonder and explore the world of aviation with the friendly people at the Good Year Base Airport and the Flightdeck Air Combat Center. They even get to fly in the Spirit of America Blimp.

programme.title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
programme.desc: Chuck travels to the Atikamekw community of Manawan where Odette, Therese, and Menic take Chuck foraging for precious wild blueberries. The three women also introduce Chuck to a partridge hunt by making a traditional slingshot with him.

programme.title: Culinary Travels With Dave Eckert
programme.desc: Explore incredible tastes of Chicago with Culinary Travels. From American gourmet and Spanish tapas to a festival that celebrates upper echelon chefs and top-shelf wine, it is time to get your napkins out for a whirlwind tour of Chicago.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Malaysia's extraordinary restaurants can be found in the most amazing locations, and Phillip Davenport takes us to the best of them. Dato' Steve Day nurtured the country's progress towards culinary excellence, and here, we taste Malaysia.

programme.title: The Toque 12
programme.desc: Catalunya is an incredible Spanish restaurant that serves distinctive cuisine.

programme.title: Ottolenghi's Mediterranean Feast
programme.desc: Yotam explores Israel's fresh produce and seafood, and cooks with cutting edge chefs. Excited by the country's abundance of fruit and vegetables, he also travels to a remote farm, and forages for ingredients in the hills of Jerusalem.

programme.title: Welcome to My Strange City
programme.desc: Welcome to Aarhus, Denmark, a city that illuminates the essential societal values Dans hold dear, values that include trust and honesty, health and happiness, and a strong belief in your fellow people. Alexandra comes to find out that collaboration can lead to prosperity.

programme.title: Wild Travels
programme.desc: Travel the country and discover the wackiest oddities it has to offer.

programme.title: Canada's National Parks
programme.desc: The bold beauty of British Columbia and Vancouver are revealed.

programme.sub-title: Best Parks You've Never Heard of
programme.desc: See where astronauts trained for moon missions and dive miles deep into crystal caves in the best parks that you've never heard of.

programme.title: Moments in Time with Elia Locardi
programme.desc: Elia charters a boat to visit the unique village of Kampong Phluk with some friends. Often referred to as the floating village during the wet season, they have the rare opportunity to walk along and photograph the colorful homes.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella Ri'chard
programme.desc: Mediterranean with Denella Ri'chard.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager explores Turkey's mystical side. From trance-inducing whirling dervishes and surreal landscapes to trippy Turkish Psychedelic Rock, meet Baba Zula, clarinet player Serkan Çagri, and experience a sensual belly dance.

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Cali is the capital of salsa, and it is also the urban center of the country's Afro-Pacific culture. Discover how salsa, not born in Colombia, became adopted as a cultural native style. We begin by meeting with the salsa band Grupo Niche.

programme.title: Me, Myself, and the World
programme.desc: Pamela explores the Tegalalang Rice Terrace and takes a yoga class.

programme.title: Bare Feet with Mickela Mallozzi
programme.desc: Mickela learns Algerian Rai with Esraa Warda, explores Bay Ridge's Little Middle East, and celebrates a Palestinian wedding with the Freedom Dabka Group. If one's soul is open, everyone can share in the joy of culture, food, and tradition.

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: Oonagh and Ethel's most vivid childhood memories include Aunt Bernadette's Beef Stew. In Carrick-on-Suir, Ethel teaches Catherine the handiwork behind the delectable Irish stew before Catherine delivers the recipe to Oonagh in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: What dish would most remind Sarah-Jo of her family in Gorey? Her mother Marian's Chicken Paprika dish. Catherine travels to Boston where she will prepare Sarah-Jo's favorite dish for her, while also exploring Boston's exciting city life.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: In Messinia, Diane visits with a good friend who helps her discover the secrets of this rich, giving land that is blessed with a perfect climate. The region is home to the world's first system of culinary provenance, and delicious recipes.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: The 19th Century was the golden age of the Mexican hacienda.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: To beat the heat, Rick leaves the kitchen for a cookout a la Mexicana.

programme.title: Jeremy Pang's Asian Kitchen
programme.desc: Jeremy's iconic first dish is Crispy Belly Pork. In the classroom Joe Swash creates Veggie Singapore Noodles. Jeremy then makes Tea Smoked Duck and Pancakes, followed by a Macanese Egg Tart, the perfect accompaniment for a cup of tea.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Colleen's family enjoys a minor league baseball game, catches and prepares their own food, discovers the importance of rescuing and rehabilitating marine life, and checks out the amazing things that can be built with sand.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Colleen's family board the historic Skunk Train for a journey through the stunning Redwood Forests. They also learn the importance of environmental protection at the Solar Living Institute, take a canoe ride on Big River, and more.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: On the borders of Mexico and Guatamala, Belize is a wild, impenetrable land, and one of the least-populated countries on Earth. Offshore, the circular Great Blue Hole is one of the largest marine sinkholes in the world at 300 meters wide, and 108 meters deep, and offers a unique diving experience.

programme.title: Green Paradise
programme.desc: The Seychelles Islands never cease to live up to their image as a Garden of Eden. These granite islands, the oldest ocean islands on Earth, were only colonized in the 18th century, and thus their natural beauty has thankfully been largely very well preserved over time.

programme.title: Lonely Planet: Best Parks Ever - America's National Parks

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas amenaza a Ámbar con lanzarla del avión, pero ella trae consigo un detonador nuclear. Rutila halla una pista de Javi en la selva. Quezada consigue a su doble para despistar al enemigo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Aurelio y Ambar, tal para cual
programme.desc: Aurelio y Ámbar son de la misma especie, hacen negocios por la adrenalina y el gozo que les produce; no por dinero. La DEA cae en la trampa de Quezada, llega al laboratorio, pero es un señuelo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Quezada mantiene su mentira con alfileres, exige la complicidad de El Cabo y el silencio a la guerrilla para engañar a Casillas. Navarro felicita a Corina, pero aún desconfía de su lealtad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: En Colombia, Aurelio increpa a los guerrilleros para que le digan la verdad, luego que Corina le informa que la muerte de Quezada puede tratarse de una farsa. Javi, oculto, ve a Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Castillo toma una foto de Milton Jiménez y la comparte con los jefes como parte del plan para acabar con el narcotráfico. Kashi le miente a Milena. Ámbar entrega el detonador a los terroristas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El señor de los cielos se salta a los subalternos y exige ver al que mueve los hilos en La Habana para aclarar asuntos de producción y jerarquía en los negocios. El Cabo tiene un soplón.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio deja en claro que él manda en el negocio y reta a Valdés, segundo al mando de la Revolución cubana, a que se pronuncie. Recibe silencio por respuesta. Casasola interviene para conciliar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Milton Jiménez queda deslumbrado con la belleza de Evelina, la prometida del Pastor Felipe, por quien se deshace en halagos y le da una jugosa limosna. Casillas huye de Cuba y arrestan a Ámbar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas alista una lluvia de plomazos contra el Cabo, luego de enterarse de que es el responsable de los ataques a su familia en Veracruz y otros atentados. Rutila trata de asociarse con su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Rutila se entera que Javi vive
programme.desc: Para borrar sus penas, Rutila va a la cama con El Dasa, pero luego se entera de que Superjavi no murió. El Cabo mata a El Pastor, para quedarse con Evelina. Castillo le pone el ojo a Zuleta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras conocer la buena noticia, Rutila llora de emoción y viaja a Colombia para abrazar a Superjavi. El Cabo consuela a la viuda, Evelina. Valdés presiona a Ámbar con el oro, o va al calabozo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: El Cabo roba terreno a Aurelio
programme.desc: Casillas descubre que el presidente protege al Cabo. Mientras, el colombiano ejecuta a sus hombres y le roba espacios al Señor de los cielos. La DEA va contra Zuleta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Rutila lleva a Javi a Las Minas del Coltán y deja que sus curvas y el contacto de la piel hagan más por su memoria que el sonido de las palabras. Zuleta y Omar están en complot frente a Castillo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente de México, borracho y drogado, amenaza al Cabo y el colombiano advierte que si no hay resultados, la sociedad se cae. Aurelio no imagina qué le espera cuando se tope con Diana.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sorprendiéndolo con los pantalones abajo, Casillas se ríe de Valdés y le da una propinita para sacárselo de encima y compensar las bajas causadas en la Isla. Diana le miente al Chivo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Javi y Rutila salvan a Kashi

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Capaz de poner y quitar presidentes a su antojo, Casillas secuestra a Begoña Morejón y pone en duda si quiere subir al poder para beneficiar a los ricos, a los pobres o a su club de amigos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Casillas va por la droga legal
programme.desc: Para acabar con la guerra, Casillas plantea el comercio legal de las drogas a la candidata, Morejón; pero no está dispuesta a negociar. Evelina firma, desconfiada, los papeles al Cabo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: Ámbar debe entregarse a la DEA
programme.desc: Corina alerta a Casillas que su extradición inmediata está aprobada, así que él obliga a Ámbar a ir con la DEA y seguir sus instrucciones.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Antes que Javier lo descubra, Rutila prefiere revelarle que el presidente fue su amante, y su reacción, cae como una bomba que desata una discusión. El Cabo y Evelina recorren los templos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio encierra a Gómez Labrador en una iglesia y le exige que confiese todo sobre la amnistía que propuso. Aunque el candidato se resiste a negociar, le pide un acuerdo con los otros carteles.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después del crimen de dos agentes de la DEA, Casillas quiere que Corina abandone la agencia y lo acompañe para pelear contra el mundo. Y a Ámbar le ordena que llame a Colon, para entregarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Corina le da instrucciones a Ámbar: debe entregar a uno del Cartel de los Soles para distraer a la DEA. Maldonado pide sexo con Casillas como parte de pago. Diana y el Cabo son socios.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.sub-title: El Cabo en guerra con Diana
programme.desc: Diana Ahumada no quiere seguir con el negocio del narco, pero "El Cabo" la obliga a continuar. Si no lo hace, causará un atentado contra su familia. Javier recuerda cuando conoció a Rutila.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pese a las advertencias, Diana Ahumada mata a dos hombres del Cabo y le exige a Ricardo que refuerce la seguridad de su familia. Dona Alba revela que Aurelio podría tener un medio hermano.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Armada hasta los dientes, Diana apunta al Cabo cuando llega con sus hombres y le indica dónde le dejó su última entrega. Arelys rompe en llanto y le cuenta toda la verdad a su jefa.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Platicamos con Adriana “Ady” Jiménez, clavadista mexicana y campeona mundial de clavados de altura, quien nos comparte cómo el deporte marcó cada etapa de su vida. Desde sus inicios en el karate hasta su ingreso al Comité Olímpico Mexicano a los 13 años, Ady Jiménez recuerda la disciplina, los sacrificios y los sueños que la formaron como atleta. Entre anécdotas de infancia, frustraciones como perder un pase olímpico en 2004 y el retiro temporal que la alejó de la plataforma durante una década, la clavadista narra su sorprendente regreso: decretar antes de saltar, vencer el miedo y abrazar la adrenalina de los 20 metros de altura. Hoy, retirada oficialmente desde 2022, Ady busca dejar un legado a través de la nueva federación de clavados, convencida de que el miedo no es un obstáculo, sino un motor. Su historia es un viaje de resiliencia, pasión y amor absoluto por el deporte.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Deportes
programme.desc: Conversamos con Marco Navarro, ciclista de alto rendimiento y actual entrenador, quien abre su historia personal y profesional con honestidad, entrega y pasión. Desde sus primeras vueltas en bicicleta por el Bosque de Aragón en la Ciudad de México, hasta representar a México a nivel internacional, Marco comparte los desafíos de un camino marcado por la constancia, las carencias y el amor al deporte. Navarro relata cómo se forjó entre campeones, sin bicicleta propia y enfrentando lesiones, como la que lo dejó dos meses sin caminar después de una medalla. Reflexiona sobre el impacto del alto rendimiento, la rivalidad en la selección nacional, y su evolución como coach, guiando a nuevas generaciones. El episodio profundiza en lo que implica mantenerse en la cima y el valor de reinventarse, descubrimos a un hombre que transformó las caídas en impulso, y que hoy busca sembrar en otros la misma determinación que lo llevó a la élite.

programme.title: Allá en el bajio
programme.desc: Tres bandidos se disputan unas tierras que podrían convertirse en el lugar perfecto para construir un hotel. Pero detrás de la ambición y el conflicto se esconde una lucha que pondrá a prueba sus intereses y cambiará el destino de los campesinos.

programme.title: La reina de Montana

programme.title: Los cuatro implacables

programme.title: Sólo el valiente

programme.title: Entre buitres
programme.desc: Old Surehand y Winnetou investigan el asesinato de una madre y su hija. Mientras el viudo culpa a los indígenas, Old Surehand sospecha de «Los Buitres», una banda de forajidos que se disfraza de indígenas para ocultar sus crímenes. Juntos intentarán descubrir a los verdaderos culpables.

programme.title: La frontera en llamas
programme.desc: Old Surehand y su fiel amigo Old Wabble persiguen a un asesino frío conocido como «El General», responsable de la muerte del hermano de Surehand. En su camino se ven atrapados en el conflicto entre colonos y comanches, al borde de la guerra. Con el apoyo de Winnetou, intentan hacer justicia y evitar un derramamiento de sangre.

programme.title: 30 Winchester para El Diablo
programme.desc: El líder de los bandidos El Diablo, que controla el país con su banda, planea conseguir oro destinado a México, pero no es el único.

programme.title: A flechas y fuego
programme.desc: El Príncipe del Petróleo, un estafador sin escrúpulos, vende al banco unos inexistentes pozos de petróleo y desvía a unos colonos para favorecer sus planes. Sin embargo, su fraude se ve amenazado cuando Winnetou y su hermano de sangre, Old Surehand, intervienen para proteger a los inocentes y desenmascarar la conspiración.

programme.title: Fuera Del Menu

programme.title: Isla De Gracia

programme.title: Amor a La Pizza
programme.desc: En Evanstown, un suburbio de Chicago, los Romano y los Juliato, dos familias rivales dedicadas a la pizza, han estado enfrentadas durante años. Pero cuando sus hijos se enamoran, este romance prohibido amenaza con sacar a la luz secretos guardados por mucho tiempo y cambiar para siempre el destino de ambas familias.

programme.title: Cambio De Rumbo
programme.desc: Después de recibir malas noticias sobre la salud de su padre, James regresa a casa de mala gana para ayudar con el negocio familiar, un alojamiento y desayuno. Allí se enfrenta a un trabajo servil que abandonó con entusiasmo antes, y a un hermano con el que no se lleva bien. Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.

programme.title: Más Gouda Imposible

Se une a un influyente crítico gastronómico para presentar su añejo gouda ahumado. Mientras su amistad se transforma en romance, la propuesta de negocios de un competidor obliga a Brie a poner en riesgo su tienda… y también su corazón.

programme.title: Renovación Del Corazón
programme.desc: Cuando los Dover se encuentran en peligro financiero, tienen que vender la casa que le dejaron los padres de Anne. La única forma de deshacerse de la casa es arreglarla, pero las cosas no salen exactamente como estaba planeado.

programme.title: El Amor Y La Estrella de Radio
programme.desc: Savannah es contratada para renovar la imagen del presentador del programa de radio número 4 de Nueva York. Pero cuando accidentalmente termina en el aire con el anfitrión, ella misma se convierte en parte del cambio de marca del programa y descubre si las diferencias en el aire o el amor tendrán la última palabra.

Aunque anhela irse tan pronto como pueda, descubre que el negocio está teniendo problemas. James enfrenta las tensiones con su hermano y debe decidir qué está dispuesto a sacrificar por los que ama.

programme.title: Más Gouda Imposible
programme.desc: Brie, propietaria de una tienda de quesos artesanales, se encuentra compitiendo por un premio de $50,000 en el Festival Anual del Queso de su pueblo. Se une a un influyente crítico gastronómico para presentar su añejo gouda ahumado. Mientras su amistad se transforma en romance, la propuesta de negocios de un competidor obliga a Brie a poner en riesgo su tienda… y también su corazón.

programme.title: Renovación Del Corazón

programme.desc: Lucía, convaleciente de una herida en la pierna, es ayudada a escapar por su amigo Ceferino y el indocumentado Coyote Chico. Conocen a un médico con licencia suspendida que lidera una banda de traficantes.

programme.title: Yambaó
programme.desc: La historia se desarrolla en Cuba en 1850, cuando aún los negros eran esclavos en los cañaverales. En uno de éstos, el capitán Jorge (Ramón Gay) y su esposa Beatriz (Rosa Elena Durgel) viven felices en la casa mayor: esperan un hijo y sus esclavos viven tranquilos y en paz con ellos. Pero una noche de luna llena, el sonido de los tambores anuncia el regreso de Yambaó (Ninón Sevilla), nieta de la santera Caridad (Fedora Capdevila), quien murió aparentemente asesinada 15 años atrás, luego de ser desterrada por el antiguo propietario de la hacienda. El hacendado tomó la decisión a causa de las prácticas mágicas de Caridad y a la adversidad que trajo a la plantación, según los mismos negros. Yambaó creció en libertad y su regreso coincide con un nuevo brote de vómito negro, plaga que no había surgido en la plantación en décadas, y que todos atribuyen a su llegada. Yambaó en realidad no es mala, pero Caridad, quien no ha muerto y se refugia en una cueva, le ha llenado el corazón de odio y sed de venganza. Jorge se mantiene al margen de la práctica de la religión yoruba de sus esclavos, pero interviene cuando descubre que quieren matar a Yambaó.

programme.title: El Escapulario
programme.desc: Una moribunda mujer le entrega al sacerdote su escapulario mientras le confiesa que es capaz de conceder milagros al que lo posea. Sus hijos son la prueba de ello, a quienes sus vidas salvó de una manera insólita.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei cree la mentira de Zhukov sobre el hijo de Anna, y ella rompe con él y aborta. Udalov mata a Gushin, quien alcanza a revelarle su nombre a Andrei. Al ver a Andrei consolar a Natasha, hija de Gushin, Anna cree que ya no la ama e intenta suicidarse; su amiga Masha la salva. Por venganza, acepta casarse con Maks, el médico que la atendió. Udalov, mientras tanto, monta en Rusia adopciones ilegales de niños extranjeros con ayuda de María Serguéievna, directora del hospital materno-infantil.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Andrei se casa con Natasha, feliz de cumplir un amor de siempre. Cuando el mafioso 'El Amo' exige a Maks pagar una deuda que amenaza su negocio, Anna se vuelve su amante para salvarlo. Vadim, amigo de Andrei, llega investigando a Udalov por tráfico de niños, y planean atraparlo juntos. Anna y Andrei se reencuentran y el amor renace, pero el embarazo de Natasha le impide dejarla. Tras discutir con él, Anna sube a un taxi cuyos pasajeros, drogados, intentan abusar de ella; en la lucha, uno muere.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Maks se divorcia de Anna y, aprovechando su detención, la deja sin nada; Andrei intercede ante el padre del joven fallecido para lograr su liberación, pues es inocente. Vadim invita a Andrei a Moscú para abrir una agencia de detectives, y Natasha lo acompaña, aunque su matrimonio se deteriora porque él no logra olvidar a Anna. En la estación, Anna salva de un intento de asesinato a Udalov: "El Amo" había enviado a un sicario para matarlo por no compartir las ganancias del tráfico de niños.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna Koroleva, la mujer más bella de la ciudad, ha aprendido a vivir rodeada de admiradores que solo ven su belleza. El bandido Zhukov, rechazado por ella, contrata matones para darle una lección... pero Andrei Savin la defiende, y Anna se enamora de él. Furioso, Zhukov descubre que ella está embarazada y asegura ante Andrei que el hijo es suyo. Herida por su desconfianza, Anna, por orgullo, confirma la mentira: él la abandona, y ella aborta. Si supiera a dónde la llevaría su orgullo...

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Agradecido, Udalov lleva a Anna a Europa, donde ella lo ayuda en su negocio sin sospechar que las adopciones son ilegales. En Moscú, la periodista Aline muestra a Vadim y Andrei un video donde Olga denuncia que Udalov la retuvo prisionera al intentar recuperar a su bebé. Udalov envía a Anna por otro niño, esta vez destinado al tráfico de órganos, pero en Moscú "El Amo" la secuestra para que revele el paradero de Udalov.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna logra escapar. Udalov, al enterarse de que Anna no recogió al niño del orfanato, viaja apresuradamente a Moscú. Temiendo por su seguridad, decide quedarse en la ciudad y le compra a Anna una clínica de cirugía plástica. Anna se sumerge en su trabajo y es feliz. Mientras tanto, la policía se acerca cada vez más a Udalov. Anna le confiesa su amor por Andrei y le pide que lo localice. Sin querer perder a su "Galatea", Udalov le miente a Anna, diciéndole que Andrei ha muerto.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna y Andrei pasan la noche juntos, pero Vadim llama desesperado: su hijo Pavlik está grave. Cuando Anna va al hospital, Andrei, dolido, la echa, y ella queda destrozada. Aline le revela que Udalov es un criminal, pero Anna se niega a creerlo -le dio una nueva vida-. Mientras Udalov intenta matar a "El Amo", Anna le cuenta que Andrei tiene el testimonio de Alexandra, que sabe demasiado; Udalov entra en pánico y borra pruebas. Vadim llama de nuevo: ha ocurrido una tragedia en la agencia…

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Una explosión destruye la agencia y sus documentos. Anna descubre quién es Udalov, que, acorralado, propone un trato antes de huir: si le cambia el rostro con cirugía, matará a Natasha, esposa de Andrei. Anna acepta y la operación es un éxito. Al saber que Natasha morirá en una hora, comprende su error e intenta advertirlo... demasiado tarde: el sicario los mata a ambos. Destrozada, entrega a Udalov a la policía -la única que lo reconoce-, vuelve a casa y adopta a Pavlik, hijo de Andrei.

programme.desc: Anna logra escapar. Udalov, al enterarse de que Anna no recogió al niño del orfanato, viaja apresuradamente a Moscú. Sin querer perder a su "Galatea", Udalov le miente a Anna, diciéndole que Andrei ha muerto.

programme.title: Belleza
programme.desc: Anna y Andrei pasan la noche juntos, pero Vadim llama desesperado: su hijo Pavlik está grave. Cuando Anna va al hospital, Andrei, dolido, la echa, y ella queda destrozada. Aline le revela que Udalov es un criminal, pero Anna se niega a creerlo -le dio una nueva vida-. Mientras Udalov intenta matar a "El Amo", Anna le cuenta que Andrei tiene el testimonio de Alexandra, que sabe demasiado; Udalov entra en pánico y borra pruebas. Vadim llama de nuevo: ha ocurrido una tragedia en la agencia…

programme.title: Belleza

programme.desc: En 2012, en La Virginia, Risaralda, Angie Xiomara, una niña de 9 años, desapareció mientras estaba al cuidado de su tío, Víctor Alfonso Cardona. Días después, su cuerpo fue hallado en un cañaduzal. Testigos y evidencias llevaron a la captura de Cardona, quien confesó el crimen. Fue condenado a 50 años de prisión por homicidio agravado y acceso carnal violento contra su sobrina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Valentina Mugno, de 14 años, fue hallada asesinada en su casa en Valledupar en 2011, tras quedar sola una noche. La investigación inicial involucró falsamente a un amigo y a su hermana antes de identificar a Víctor Alfonso Márquez como sospechoso. Una segunda víctima que logró sobrevivir un ataque similar fue clave para el caso. Casi seis años después, Márquez fue condenado a 44 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2009, Ángela María Mejía confesó matar a su esposo Edilson Guzmán. Sus amigos Pedro y Yolanda la encubrieron, pero Yolanda luego descubrió que Pedro era amante de Ángela y la delató. Ángela fue capturada por homicidio y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Cajamarca, Tolima, el líder ambientalista César García fue asesinado frente a su familia tras oponerse a la minera AngloGold Ashanti. Aunque se sospechó de un vínculo con la empresa, las autoridades lo descartaron. Una carta de suicidio reveló que el verdadero autor fue Álvaro Meléndez, vecino con quien García tuvo un litigio de tierras. Meléndez permanece detenido esperando juicio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Andrés Felipe Fierro, joven ingeniero ambiental, fue asesinado en 'Charco Azul', Florencia, Caquetá. La investigación reveló que Rocío Quintero, su amante, y Jarol Villegas, esposo de ella, estuvieron involucrados en el crimen. Un testigo clave confirmó las sospechas. Jarol confesó ser el autor intelectual y fue condenado a 32 años de prisión. Rocío permanece prófuga, rehaciendo su vida en Argentina.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en la Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, dos hermanos desaparecieron cerca de la vereda Nuevo Mundo. Tras sospechar inicialmente de la madre, la investigación reveló que David Barbosa Arrieta, empleado de confianza del padre, había abusado y asesinado a los menores. Las pruebas recopiladas confirmaron su culpabilidad, y Barbosa fue condenado a 60 años de prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2016, en Socorro, Santander, Yesenia Bernal fue asesinada para robarle a su bebé recién nacido. Su amiga Edilsa María Díaz, tras perder su propio embarazo y temiendo perder a su pareja, fingió estar embarazada y planeó el crimen junto a Juan Carlos Vega para apropiarse de la niña. Ambos fueron capturados y condenados: Edilsa a 35 años y Juan Carlos a una pena similar.

programme.title: Roger
programme.desc: The lively adventures of a little girl, the carefree, joyful and occasionally perky Fatou, and an alien, the clumsy Roger, on a tropical island… Throughout their adventures, they trigger small accidents that sometimes grow into major disasters, but (almost) always end on a happy note. In short, Roger and Fatou spend their time saving the island from their own mistakes and blunders.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Woodventures
programme.desc: "Woodventures" is an animated series for preschool children. The main characters are wooden toys: Kitty Meow, Doggy Woof-Woof, Piggy Oink, Horsey Yee-Ho-Ho and Elephant Pawoo. The toys live in a small wooden town (the prototype of a child's play room). Every toy has its own unique personality and reacts to different circumstances appropriately. With the help of the invisible narrator, the toys, along with the audience solve different tasks, play and take part in adventures. "Woodventures" is a musical series with lots of songs and dances. Some of the songs represent our characters and appear in each series, and some of the songs are related to the events in the series, so it is only found in that particular episode.Each episode presents a playful and learning environment.

programme.title: Cutie Cubies
programme.desc: An animation series about the adventures of four aliens - Cubies: Captain, Boatswain, Navigator, and Doctor. Having arrived on our planet and disguised as representatives of the local flora and fauna of the cubic form: a yellow chicken, a red rabbit, a blue aquarium and a bush of green grass, they are learning the diverse phenomena of our planet Earth.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Heroes of Envell
programme.desc: Present days. Saint Petersburg. Four friends – Art, Kira, Phil and Vic are the coolest gamers in school. Eventually they find a suspicious laptop with «Heroes of Envell» game installed on it. Turns out that this very laptop is a portal to another dimension, a game realm which is full of adventures and real-life danger. The game realm is a blend of medieval, steampunk and futurism. You never know what really awaits our heroes. Just like the design of the game, the game logic is very unpredictable. You start with a quest and then it becomes a race right until it all grows into a tricky brainteaser. But be sure about one thing – there is no boring or easy way in here. programme.title: Bat Pat
programme.desc: The series follows the comedy adventures of Bat Pat and the Silver brothers Martin, Leo and Rebecca as they unravel mysteries and cross paths with supernatural creatures of the night that lurk, haunt, shriek and dig themselves up in every dark corner of their home in Fogville, a small town that seems to be the center of all things weird in the world, a veritable magnet to ghosts, mummies, witches, creatures, werewolves and things that go bump in the night. Bat Pat will prove that the supernatural isn’t always evil but just misunderstood. Our heroes will come to understand something important: the supernatural “bad guys” are not really bad, but normal people whose actions are misunderstood by the more inhabitants of Fogville and what they really want is... just help!

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Magic Lantern
programme.desc: Animation series “Magic Lantern” tells little viewers wonderful adventure stories, based on classic literature plots. Little video games fan Mike and his smart sister Kate watch and discuss each story presented as a strip film. Funny stories will help seeing classic stories from the new side and prove that world classic literature is exciting and interesting.

programme.title: Invent'Tom
programme.desc: Meet Tom, Car City’s very own inventor! In his high-tech lab, he creates the wackiest inventions to solve his friend’s problems.

programme.title: Pincode
programme.desc: Carlin says he can predict earthquakes, but Dokko doesn't believe him until one happens! Even then Dokko sets out to prove that it was only a coincidence, and that earthquakes cannot be predicted. In this episode, kids learn about the causes of earthquakes, volcanoes, and wind storms.

programme.title: Pincode
programme.desc: Pin misses his Bi-Bi and wants to find a way to see and communicate with him across great distances. He decides he wants a moving picture so he can see Bi-Bi in action! In this episode, kids learn about movies and video and how they are processed and made. Featuring scientist Vladimir Kozmich Zvorikin.

Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Magic Lantern
programme.desc: Animation series “Magic Lantern” tells little viewers wonderful adventure stories, based on classic literature plots. Little video games fan Mike and his smart sister Kate watch and discuss each story presented as a strip film. Funny stories will help seeing classic stories from the new side and prove that world classic literature is exciting and interesting.

programme.title: Invent'Tom
programme.desc: Meet Tom, Car City’s very own inventor! In his high-tech lab, he creates the wackiest inventions to solve his friend’s problems.

programme.title: Pincode
programme.desc: Carlin says he can predict earthquakes, but Dokko doesn't believe him until one happens! Even then Dokko sets out to prove that it was only a coincidence, and that earthquakes cannot be predicted. In this episode, kids learn about the causes of earthquakes, volcanoes, and wind storms.

programme.title: Pincode
programme.desc: Pin misses his Bi-Bi and wants to find a way to see and communicate with him across great distances. He decides he wants a moving picture so he can see Bi-Bi in action! In this episode, kids learn about movies and video and how they are processed and made. Featuring scientist Vladimir Kozmich Zvorikin.

programme.title: RoboFuse
programme.desc: Robo works tirelessly with his loyal friends to protect Car City from Zitron's constant schemes to steal the city's energy source.

programme.title: Tiny Town
programme.desc: Join the friendly vehicles of Tiny Town as they play games, go on adventures and solve problems together.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Wrecks, Reefs, and the Secret Life of Sponges - Islamorada is a diver’s dream — but we’re going deeper than the postcard views. We explore iconic wrecks, glide over kaleidoscopic reefs, and shine a spotlight on the reef’s unsung heroes: sponges, the quiet powerhouses that keep the waters here uniquely clear. Finally, we dive into the newest breakthroughs in coral restoration that could change everything.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Alaskan Fishing, Foraging, & Mountainside Cooking with Local Legends"
programme.desc: Hop in the float plane—a new episode of DIRT just dropped. The DIRT crew made their way to Alaska, “the land of earth, sea, and sky.” All feast, no sleep is the name of the game as Josh makes the most of Alaska’s abundant and legendary daylight alongside local guides, fishermen, and even a couple grizzlies. There’ll be plenty of time to hibernate in winter. But for now—join us—there are halibut to filet, rainforest ’shrooms to forage, and mountainside meals to cook up.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Often misunderstood, brown bears are one of North America's most formidable predators. Taking part in a scientific collaring program to better understand predator-prey interactions, Dan Cabela travels to Kodiak Island to meet the research team.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.sub-title: "Glenn Arbor with Reel Tales Fishing Charter"
programme.desc: Danny discovers two northern Michigan watering holes and fishing with a local guide, Reel Tales Fishing Charters.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "Alaska's Massive Marvels: A Boating Expedition through America's Last Frontier Pt 2
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken travel to South Carolina's Lowcountry for a massive barbecue charity event supporting children battling serious illness. After serving up smoke for a great cause, they spend an extra day in the marsh chasing redfish and speckled trout.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Join the Mayor of Destin as he ventures into the world of coastal fishing, leaving the city behind for a day of fun and unexpected challenges. With plenty of laughs and surprising twists, this episode showcases the Mayor in a whole new light.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Could Bull Sharks Survive In The Great Lakes"
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.sub-title: "Jonah Wasn't Alone Modern People Swallowed By Whales"
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Despite the weather, Capt. Josh Calhoon and his wife Anna take a day off to target mangrove snapper before moving into deeper water to search for quality amberjacks.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: On this episode of Goin' Coastal, Capt. Josh Calhoon brings his store manager Isaiah Lopez with him on a day of inshore fishing for trout and redfish.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt. Josh heads offshore with Marcus Castro for a day of fishing, hoping to reel in the perfect catch for tonight’s family dinner.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Josh Calhoon takes Scott from Yo-Zuri out for a day on the water, with hopes of adding a few new species to his catch list.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff join a local biologist searching for a white rhino whose tracking collar has failed, leaving it exposed to poachers. As they follow its trail through the African bush, the search builds toward a heart-pounding encounter that none of them will ever forget.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle takes to the water in a way few anglers dare, fishing from a Sea-Doo in search of the ancient lake sturgeon, a species that’s been around since the age of the dinosaurs and can live over 100 years. Hooking into one of North America’s largest freshwater fish from a personal watercraft proves to be a challenge unlike any other.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff embark on a 20-day mission into the Everglades to find the invasive pythons that are plaguing the ecosystem. These apex predators have eliminated more than 90% of fur-bearing animals in their new home. Can they turn the tide, or is the Everglades already lost?

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff get bit by catfish in Southern Oklahoma with YouTuber Nate Williams of Adrenaline Rush Adventures while using the most primitive fishing tactic - hand fishing. Learn from the Chickasaw Nation about the history of this method that has been used by Native Americans for thousands of years.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he journeys to his final destination in Namibia in pursuit of the elusive Damara Dik-Dik. These tiny antelope—famed for their large eyes and extremely shy nature—present a unique challenge even for a seasoned hunter. Active only in the early mornings and late evenings, their limited movement leaves Mark with a very narrow window of opportunity to successfully harvest one and cap off his African adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "North American Deer Slam - Mexican Texanus Whitetail"
programme.desc: Continuing on with his quest for The North America Deer Slam, Mark Peterson packs his Gunwerks Nexus 300 PRC rifle for a hunt in Mexico targeting the elusive Mexican Texanus Whitetail from elevated blinds. The outfitter here has done an amazing job managing the deer numbers and age groups to grow giant whitetails. Mark is anticipating the pre-rut will get these big bucks moving.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Orange Free State of South Africa: White Blesbuck, Tsessebe & More"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson’s South African adventure continues! In this episode, he takes on the rugged terrain of the Orange Free State while pursuing four unique and challenging trophy species. Watch as Mark puts his spot-and-stalk skills to the test against the lightning-fast Kalahari Springbok and the elusive Common Reedbuck hidden in thick cover. The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Eastern Cape of South Africa: Cape Grysbok"
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa continues as he transitions from daytime stalks to the stealth of the night. In this episode, the focus shifts to one of the most elusive members of the "Tiny Ten"—the Cape Grysbok. Primarily nocturnal, the Cape Grysbok is a master of blending into the thick brush making it very difficult to get a good shot off. Hunting these ghosts requires a different set of skills and equipment, often involving spotlighting from the back of a Land Cruiser to catch the reflection of their eyes in the dark. Watch as Mark and the crew navigate the rugged Eastern Cape terrain under the stars, utilizing spotlights to locate their target.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Hunting Giant Eurasian Brown Bear in Croatia"
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he embarks on a thrilling hunt in Croatia for the Eurasian Brown Bear. Experience the beauty of the Croatian wilderness and witness the skill and precision required for a successful hunt. Follow along as Mark faces all the challenges dealing with wind and a big bear that is extremely smart, making it very difficult to harvest this amazing animal. Don’t miss this exciting hunting adventure with Mark Peterson in Croatia!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Cinnamon Teal Everywhere- First Hunt In Peru | , South American Waterfowl Slam"
programme.desc: Mark's quest for the South America Waterfowl Slam has now taken him to Peru where he finds a surprising density of Cinnamon Teal. Although he already checked this species off the list in Argentina, his first hunt in Peru proves to be one of the best Cinnamon Teal shoots of his life. This is only the first afternoon and there are 5 days left to hunt the remaining 7 species.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.sub-title: The - "More Than Just A Trigger Pull"
programme.desc: The crew is loaded up and headed to Utah for an early season velvet mule deer hunt! This trip quickly becomes about more than just the trigger pull as Austin and Jerry both find themselves going after two giant mule deer that they put all of their time and energy into chasing.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we honor the life and legacy of Zumbrota Police officer Gary Schroeder while enjoying one of his favorite pastimes..Turkey Hunting! Gary's wife Kim, their three boys and nephew embark on a Turkey hunt in Central Minnesota to chase after some gobblers. In addition to honoring Gary and chasing Turkeys, we discuss the Invisible wounds that our servicemen and women face daily while protecting their communities and our freedoms. We also celebrate Johnstown Colorado Scheels Hometown Hero, Matt Hill.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode of American Heroes Outdoors, We shift our focus to our Healthcare Heroes. Over the past 2+ years of the Covid 19 pandemic, Healthcare workers have gone above and beyond the call of duty to ensure they provide the best care to their communities even in the toughest of situations. Join us as we spend a day of Ice Fishing with Lock Jaw Guide service in Panfish paradise with our Healthcare Heroes and hear their stories of service and sacrifice

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: 82 year old Navy veteran with more than 2.7 million TikTok followers, Patriotic Kenny talks of how he helps other vets through him gifting mobility scooters to fellow veterans in need.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Domingo Martinez recounts overcoming the life altering effects of trauma he received as a child and on the DMZ.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Hunting isn't about the size of the buck, it's about something much bigger. Jeff Lindsey of The Lindsey Way gets to experience one of the most special moments a father and hunter can ask for, introducing his kids to the outdoors. These are the hunts they'll remember forever.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: For Mike Pentecost and his son Jacob, Illinois deer camp has become a tradition they look forward to every single year. It’s a place filled with memories, time spent together, and a shared love for chasing whitetails.But this trip carries a little more meaning. At 17 years old, Jacob is heading into his final year of being eligible for Illinois’ special youth season and he and Mike are hoping to make one last trip to deer camp count.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Years of hunting the same piece of ground teaches you that some patterns are worth trusting. WoodHaven’s Josh Anderson heads back to the family property for a mid-October hunt, relying on years of history and a pattern that has produced time and time again. With the calendar lining up, Josh climbs into a stand that seems to come alive around the same time every October.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Mark Scroggins and his family are in Oklahoma and spot a big gobbler from the road. They are pretty sure they can get in position to call him in but they have to be quick without being seen. His step-daughter Destiny is behind the trigger and Mark just about puts this ol gobbler in her lap!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This hunt was years in the making. Michael Hunsucker with Heartland Bowhunter had several years of history with this buck, including an incredible encounter with him over a decoy the year before. Heading into this hunt, we knew exactly what deer we were after, we just had to get back into his core area and make it happen.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Mike heads to South Seas Island Resort for an unforgettable day inshore.

programme.title: Reel Animals
programme.desc: Mike visits Crystal River and fishes with one of his Citrus County friends, Capt JC Livingston, where they battle the good, the bad and the ugly that comes with Tarpon fishing!

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: With rods bent and fish in the box, Capt. Josh and Alex Fogg reel in a variety of species to assist with important research on fish growth and population health.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: Capt Josh and Johnny from Johnny Jigs head out with gorgeous weather on their side to hit some reefs and put the jigs to work!

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Capt. CA looks back on 20 years of Flats Class TV and picks some of his favorite moments to revisit.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA’s skiff gets an upgrade. Now no fish is safe.

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: Low country BBQ and Redfish? What more do you want?

programme.title: Flats Class
programme.desc: CA heads to the scenic Low country of South Carolina for part one of an epic two-part redfish adventure.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is fishing in Pine Island Sound, Fl with Ty Nelson, Founder of Florida Fishing Products.

programme.title: Captain's Log
programme.desc: Capt. Jonathan Moss is at Highland Park Fish Camp, Speck fishing with Capt. James Hillman.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Over a decade after the game changing Longbeard XR was introduced by Winchester, the wait is finally over for their next ground breaking turkey load. After years of perfecting the recipe behind the scenes, Winchester finally unveiled the new Longbeard TSS at a turkey camp in northern Michigan. First watch the jaw dropping Longbeard TSS pattern board testing, then see it go to work on some spring gobblers.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nestled in the hills of Ohio just west of the Appalachians is a very special deer camp ripe with memories from deer season’s past. With the development of the 350 Legend straight-walled cartridge by Winchester in 2019, a world of opportunities now existed in states like Ohio and Michigan. In this episode, with the 350 Legend in hand, three mature whitetails meet their maker, from the same blind, over the course of three seasons.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: After multiple days in Alaska, it was time for the last trip out to sea. The crew got to experience the sights on this trip, like God Valley and others. And of course catch more Alaskan fish.

programme.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors
programme.desc: Down in Sebastion, the monster snook wait. These fish are so elusive, men have gotten divorced chasing these things. These can be once in a lifetime fish, and even then it's not a guarantee.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: David Lindsey’s 2024 Iowa season was anything but ordinary. He set his sights on one of the greatest bucks ever to roam The Lindsey Way farm — a deer he called “Pretty Boy.” From close calls to wild twists, David’s pursuit was full of highs, lows, and more excitement than any hunt in recent memory. But somewhere in the chaos, another story unfolded — a tough old buck that survived EHD and became just a little too predictable. David seized the opportunity, made the shot, and finally got some blood under his belt for the season.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.
Joe Miles – Owner of Asio Gear, chases big whitetails in Kentucky, Kansas and Mexico!

programme.title: HuntStand Presents
programme.desc: Ismael Garcia was just a young soldier when a tragic incident in Afghanistan changed his life forever. He was left wounded and scarred, but the hardest part came after he returned home. Hunting had always been his escape. But after war, everything felt different — until he picked up a bow.
Kris Seymour chases big whitetails in NE Kansas!

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.sub-title: The - "Pennsylvania Turkey OPENER | THREE Turkeys BEFORE Breakfast"
programme.desc: Join Jerry, Austin, and friends as they head afield for the Pennsylvania turkey opener.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: Country Music Artist Josh Thompson takes to the hills of Utah looking to get a break from the norm.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila and Rosa swear that now nothing and no one can separate them. Rosa wants to be reunited with her sister, Mother Isabel. Rosa, alone with her sister, shows her true face: cold, calm and above all vengeful. The two sisters confront each other over what they want for Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max now understands why Camila did not marry him. Max and Camila meet with Rosa. Rosa Blanco and Fausto plan to ally themselves to bring down Ezequiel, but he does not trust her and thinks it is a trap for him and so he decides to ally himself with Ezequiel, with the purpose of murdering Rosa.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Inspector Torrealba demands that Rosa testify about what happened in the past crime of Leoncio Lopez Mendez. With pain she relives the moments when Ezequiel arrived and murdered Leoncio and then left the place without any remorse. Fausto and Ezequiel continue with their plan to murder Rosa Blanco so that she does not tell what she knows.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: During an event in Mascarada Rosa is received by Camila to enjoy seeing all her enemies gathered in the same place. Ezequiel and Fausto each celebrate the fall of the other and are united only by their intention to kill Rosa; Marcelina, feels fear and shame; Elda, assures that Rosa is there to take revenge. Projection of the video that shows how Fausto murdered Celso.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel receives a note from El Doliente, anticipating his death. The plan against Rosa Blanco failed. She continues to relate the events of the past; Ezequiel, forcing her to take the murder weapon, managed to get her to be blamed for this murder, for which she paid so many years of unjust imprisonment.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Ezequiel tries to abuse Camila, a gloved hand hits him. Everyone blames Camila and she defends herself saying she did not see the murderer. Torrealba insists on interrogating her. Everyone: Octavia, Astrid, Max, Marcelina, Leandro, Gregorio and even Sebastián had motives to kill Ezequiel. Only Max is arrested, as the presumed perpetrator of the crime.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max is arrested and Camila assures that he is innocent. Santiago tells the inspector that he saw Max cleaning the object with which Ezequiel was killed and, sadly, he concludes that he and Camila were the perpetrators. The interrogations continue.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Torrealba exposes before two officers the case of the crime of Ezequiel Lopez Mendez, he is interrupted by Marcelina who comes to confess her guilt, Torrealba does not believe her. Rosa accuses Octavia of being the one who thought of abandoning Camila and convinced Marcelina to do so. Octavia mocks her and Camila, blind with anger, throws her out of her house.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila accepts that Max is the man she has loved the most and confides that she feels a great hatred for Marcelina, because being her mother's best friend, she was the one who betrayed her the worst and left her in the street, when she was only a five year old girl. Max refuses to believe it.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 5
programme.desc: Trauma overwhelms the heart and mind, but healing requires grief. This lesson guides you to honor your triggers as maps of pain and recovery, reclaim choice in how you live with trauma, and create space for healing while moving through grief with awareness and care.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 6
programme.desc: Loss is inevitable, but self-blame and unhealed wounds can deepen the pain. By facing reality and healing old patterns, we find freedom and healthier love.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 7
programme.desc: Betrayal brings a unique grief because it comes from someone we trusted. The search for answers can keep us stuck, as the mind looks for reasons while the heart seeks healing. This lesson helps you process the pain, work with difficult thoughts, and rebuild trust and hope for the future.

programme.title: Help for the Hurting Heart with David Kessler
programme.sub-title: Help for the Hurting Heart Day 8
programme.desc: Job loss and estrangement can shake your identity and bring deep, often unspoken grief. This lesson helps you honor the sadness and anger, redefine yourself beyond work or broken ties, and move forward with clarity, confidence, and self-compassion.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 4 explores opening to joy by intentionally taking in the good. We examine habits of threat, perfectionism, and resistance, and practice savoring what’s nourishing and life-giving. Through gentle curiosity, this lesson shows how joy can restore resilience and help us meet life with more ease.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 5 introduces the practice of lovingkindness, or metta—a meditation rooted in connection and care. Using gentle phrases, we affirm our shared humanity and inner potential for growth and love. This practice invites curiosity rather than force, allowing experience to unfold naturally.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 6 explores interdependence—the deeper truth that nothing exists alone. Through reflection and lovingkindness for all beings, we recognize the countless conditions that support our lives. This practice helps dissolve isolation and reconnect us with the larger web of life we belong to.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 7 brings the course into action by exploring intention, execution, and letting go. Through reflection on core values, we learn to act with greater integrity, mindfulness, and compassion. This final practice celebrates growth and invites us to carry compassionate resilience into daily life.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr Jill Bolte Taylor - Whole Brain Living and Choice
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr Jill Bolte Taylor, a Harvard-trained and published neuroanatomist. She shares with us the idea of cellular circuitry and how there are four distinct modules of cells that make up who we are, combining the thinking mind and the emotional side. She discusses her new book, Whole Brain Living: The Anatomy of Choice and the Four Characteristics that Drive Our Life.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Robert Thurman - Wisdom is Bliss
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Professor Robert Thurman, the preeminent scholar and interpreter of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy for the modern world, who believes that Wisdom is Bliss and in fact, that’s the name of his latest book. Thurman is a very close friend of HH Dalai Lama and today he discusses deep ideas about mindfulness and presence and leads us on a joyful exploration into the nature of reality through Buddha’s threefold curriculum.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr Harley Rotbart - No Regrets Parenting

He shares special keys for parents to guide children to live a life of wonder and contentment by conscious parenting.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr. Michael Tobin - Secrets to a Loving Relationship
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews marital and family psychologist Dr. Michael Tobin who believes the secret to a happy, long-lasting relationship is mutual respect for one another. He’s been with his life partner, soulmate, and wife, Deborah, for 47 years, and in practice as a psychologist for more than 45 years. His most recent book, Riding the Edge, A Love Song to Deborah, chronicles his six-month transformative journey.

programme.title: The Aware Show
programme.sub-title: The Aware Show: Dr. James Greenblatt --- Nutritional Solutions in Psychiatry
programme.desc: Host Lisa Garr interviews Dr. James Greenblatt, a pioneer in the field of integrative medicine who has been treating patients with eating disorders for many decades. His nutritional approach to psychiatry is revolutionary and has helped patients worldwide. He is the author of seven books, including Answers to Anorexia and Finally Focused: The Breakthrough Natural Treatment Plan for ADHD.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Los mejores pilotos de Buffalo, tanto novatos como veteranos, viajan a California para combates aéreos en aviones de combate reales.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El homenaje de Mikey al Día D, un salto en paracaídas con 20 paracaidistas, encuentra un obstáculo cuando Joe se niega a pilotar su DC-3 hasta la zona de salto.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El copiloto novato Scott se enfrenta a su peor pesadilla cuando un motor Curtiss C-46 Commando y una baja niebla obligan a un aterrizaje aterrador. El joven y ambicioso volador Alex debe demostrar su valía cuando el piloto principal de Buffalo le da el control del Douglas DC-4 de 20 toneladas por primera vez.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Una racha de mala suerte hace que el 66 grados cumpleaños del piloto en jefe Arnie huya del infierno y amenaza con estropear su sorpresa de cumpleaños traviesa. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy está desesperado por ascender en los rangos, pero una novata podría arrojar una llave en sus planes, después de que la tripulación trabaja toda la noche para convertir el DC-4 en un tanque de gas volador.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando una falla de energía deja a Rankin Inlet expuesto a los elementos brutales del norte, el capitán Justin corre para entregar un generador de emergencia. El ayudante de rampa Jeremy intenta adelantarse a la compañera de trabajo Audrey entrenando a un nuevo empleado de la India para reemplazarlo. Y cuando la recesión pisa los talones de Joe, intenta negociar un acuerdo de $ 7 millones.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: El mecánico Cory corre contra el reloj para convertir dos bombas de agua de corto alcance en aviones transatlánticos para el viaje épico a Turquía. Depende del ingeniero Adam sacar a la tripulación del C-46 de un atasco en una pista de aterrizaje remota en menos 40. Y cuando el capitán Devan y el copiloto Scott encuentran la amenaza de la cizalladura del viento en el famoso Bear Rock.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Un vuelo charter cae por las grietas después de que los McBryans asisten a una boda familiar salvaje, y un furioso Joe saca al capitán Justin de los vuelos de prueba de Turquía para hacer el trabajo. La tarea de Justin es trasladar a un británico impaciente, su perro y todas sus posesiones mundanas a un remoto puesto avanzado del norte, pero el clima no está cooperando.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: AJ y Candace se casan en el Castillo de Hielo. Un frustrado Chuck intenta que la Electra le pague. Mikey, desconcertado, intenta hornear un pastel para el cumpleaños de Joe. Y en Terranova, una fuga de combustible, un curso de supervivencia aleccionador y un trágico choque sacudieron a la tripulación de Turquía. Cuando los fuertes vientos brinden la ventana meteorológica tan esperada.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: La tripulación de Turquía hace el salto crítico sobre el Atlántico Norte. Pero en el camino a Portugal, un equipo se ve obligado a regresar. Sin potencia en un motor y sin forma de mantener la altitud, deben regresar a Santa María, donde el aeropuerto está en alerta de emergencia completa. Y Mikey y Scott buscan una nueva rampie, mientras que las esperanzas de Jeremy se desploman aún más.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Las tripulaciones C-46 y DC-4 compiten contra el deshielo primaveral para volar equipos mineros a una pista de aterrizaje en un lago congelado. Jeremy intenta alcanzar a sus compañeros rampies Audrey y Wilf. Y en el último tramo a Turquía, Arnie y Justin se enfrentan a algunos volcanes serios y al intenso tráfico aéreo del Mediterráneo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Después de miles de horas de preparación minuciosa y vuelo peligroso, un terrible accidente devasta a la tripulación de los bombarderos de agua en Turquía, y a todos en Buffalo. La primera carrera de Wilf como azafata levanta las cejas entre el personal. Y un aficionado a los aviones escoceses cumple el sueño de su vida cuando Joe lo deja viajar en el asiento del capitán de su DC-3.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando su esposo renuncia después de un reventón con Joe, Kelly se pone en una posición terrible. ¿Se quedará en Buffalo o se irá? Scott recibe la noticia de que debe retirarse del vuelo para que otro copiloto pueda acelerar el paso al capitán. Él hace todo lo posible para asegurar una nueva carta, pero su rival también quiere volar el nuevo trabajo.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Joe pelea una demanda de Transport Canada contra la aerolínea.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
programme.desc: Cuando un incendio mortal destruye un puesto de avanzada en el norte una semana antes de Navidad.

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)
